newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani authorities seize drugs, guns.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani authorities seize drugs, guns.

text.p: Pakistani authorities have seized separate consignments of smuggled weapons and drugs originating in Afghanistan, officials said on Thursday.
A customs official said his men had found 23 Kalashnikov assault rifles, two sub-machine guns and 20,000 cartridges in a truck at Gadani near Karachi on Wednesday. The driver escaped.
The official said the weaponry had come from Afghanistan and was bound for the troubled southern port city of Karachi.
In a separate swoop, excise and taxation officials, acting on a tip-off, intercepted a truck near Attock on the boundary between North West Frontier Province and Punjab province.
Officials said they found 5.84 tonnes of hashish on the truck carrying animal bones when it arrived at a checkpoint at dawn on Wednesday. Two drivers and a cleaner were arrested.
Pakistan is a principal transit route for hashish and opium grown in Afghanistan and often processed in tribal border areas where the Islamabad government exerts only partial control.
